sentences.text: The original agreement and the copy do not state the same pre-payment charge in clause 9.3.
The original agreement states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding in clause 9.3, and the copy states 3% of the principal outstanding in clause 9.3.
The same difference also appears in the schedule of charges, which lists 2% for the original agreement and 3% for the copy.
